title: profile backfill + changelog pipeline with safety heuristics and human review gate
author: Priya Das
description: Motivation: We need repeatable, auditable model-profile backfills for older models and a deterministic changelog assembly step that can produce human-friendly release notes and machine-readable deltas for rollouts. This PR implements a pipeline that: 1) backfills missing performance profiles using a bounded sample harness and heuristics (latency/throughput/cost buckets), 2) generates a compact changelog entry for each onboard/update event that highlights profile deltas and recommended rollout configs, and 3) introduces a safety gate that queues changelog entries for optional human review when heuristics detect large regressions or quantization-affecting changes. Design highlights: - backfill_worker: orchestrates lightweight profiling jobs constrained by a per-model budget and historical seq-len distribution. Profiles are stored as compact JSON with provenance and a profile-stability score. - delta_scorer: compares new profile to the latest stable profile and computes a small set of actionable diffs (e.g. 95p latency +15ms, median tokens/sec -12%). - changelog_assembler: emits both a markdown blurb for release notes and a machine-readable changelog fragment (compact delta + provenance). - safety hooks: heuristic rules (thresholds configurable via registry flags) that mark entries for 'human_review' when deltas exceed multi-dim thresholds or when tagging changes (quantization, kernel switch) occur. - audit trail: every assembled changelog fragment references commit, CI snapshot id, and the profiling sample id so bugs are traceable. Work items completed (checklist): - [x] profiling harness integration with existing perf-canary runner - [x] bounded backfill worker and retry/backoff for infra throttling - [x] delta scoring implementation with unit tests and sampled benchmarks - [x] changelog assembler that produces markdown and JSON fragments - [x] human_review queue API and simple console page for ops to approve/reject - [x] migration script to backfill ~250 historical models (dry-run safe) - [x] docs: models/upgrade-guide.md and registry/ops-runbook.md Testing and validation: - Unit tests added for delta_scorer and changelog_assembler (tests/test_delta_scorer.py, tests/test_changelog.py). - Backfill was run in dry-run mode on a 50-model sample. Results: median-profile stability score improved coverage from 72% -> 94% for recent variants; two models were flagged and pushed to human_review due to quantization-affecting deltas. - End-to-end CI initially failed on an intermittent benchmark (bench/canary) due to ephemeral throttling; re-run after adding an exponential backoff fixed it. Benchmarks (summary): - sample-run (n=50 models) produced average 95p latency delta of +8ms on quantized variants (within configured threshold). - throughput regressions were observed on 3/50 models; those were placed in human_review with suggested rollouts. Rollout plan: - squash-merge to main after approvals. - enable pipeline in staging for 72h with sparse backfills (budget 10s per model) and monitor profile stability dashboards. - after safe staging run, enable migration to backfill remaining historical models with a soft quota. Operational notes: - New flags: registry.backfill.budget_ms, registry.changelog.human_review_thresholds (see docs). - Added small console page (registry -> changelog queue) under redwood-console to review flagged changelogs (initial UI is minimal). Risks and mitigations: - False positives in heuristics: mitigated by conservative thresholds and human_review route. - Extra load on canary infra: mitigated by per-model budget and exponential backoff. Related: ENG-4921 (backfill infra), ENG-5034 (changelog UX).

release_notes: Introduce profile backfill pipeline and changelog assembly with human review gating. Adds operator-facing queue for flagged changelog entries and a migration script to backfill historical models. Configurable thresholds control which deltas require human review. See docs/models/upgrade-guide.md for rollout steps.
notes_for_oncall: If backfill creates sustained load on canary infra, temporarily set registry.backfill.enabled=false or lower registry.backfill.budget_ms. Human_review queue can be paused via registry.changelog.human_review_enabled=false.
